S0.title: My account: contacts, orders of both train types, paid orders, luggage consignments

They refresh their list of orders twice — for high-speed (GaoTie/DongChe) trains and for regular ('Other' type) trains, which are kept separately — and then refresh the orders once more with the filter 'Paid' status. Finally they look up the luggage consignments registered on their account. Nothing is searched, booked or paid.

S1.title: Buying a high-speed train ticket with food on the train, insurance and luggage; paying from the account; collecting the ticket and boarding
S1.description: A registered passenger logs in with a username and password. They search for high-speed (GaoTie/DongChe) trains from Shanghai to Suzhou departing on 1 October 2026 and open the details of the first trip in the results. They look at the food menu offered on that trip. They open their contact book and take the first contact as the passenger. They book one first-class seat on that trip for this contact, adding food on the train (the first dish from the menu), assurance (insurance) of the first type and luggage consignment of 2 kg to a consignee. They refresh their list of orders, open the new order and check its price. They pay for the order from their internal account balance. They collect the ticket for the order and then enter the station (board the train) with it. Finally they look up the luggage consignment record and the assurance record of the order.

Book one first-class seat on the trip for this contact, with food on the train, assurance (insurance) of the first type and luggage consignment of 2 kg to a consignee
Refresh the list of orders
Open the new order

S2.title: Buying a regular train ticket with station food and no insurance; paying and cancelling with a refund; a second order rebooked to a cheaper seat class
S2.description: A registered passenger logs in. They search for regular trains (the 'Other' train type, not high-speed) from Shanghai to Nanjing departing on 1 October 2026 and open the details of the first trip in the results. They browse the food stores at Suzhou station. They open their contact book and take the first contact as the passenger. They book one first-class seat on that regular train for this contact with food from a station store, without assurance (insurance) and without luggage consignment. They refresh their list of orders, pay for the order from the internal account balance, ask how much would be refunded if the order were cancelled, and cancel the order. Then they book another first-class seat on the same regular train for the same contact with the same station food, refresh the orders, pay for the new order, and rebook this paid ticket to a second-class seat on the same regular train: the second-class ticket is cheaper, so the difference is refunded to the internal account balance.

S3.title: Family trip on a high-speed train: two passengers, a new contact, station food, assurance and a small consignment; paying for both orders
S3.description: A registered passenger logs in and searches for high-speed (GaoTie/DongChe) trains from Shanghai to Suzhou departing on 1 October 2026, opens the details of the first trip found and browses the food stores at Suzhou station. They open their contact book, take the first contact and also add a new contact (a companion with an ID card). They book a first-class seat on that trip for the first contact with food from a station store, assurance (insurance) of the first type and a luggage consignment of only 0.5 kg to a consignee; then they book a second-class seat on the same trip for the new contact — without food, assurance or consignment. They refresh the list of orders, open both new orders and pay for both from the internal account balance. Finally they check what a 0.5 kg consignment within the region costs and look at the list of assurance types.

S4.title: A newly registered passenger with an empty balance: booking with food on the train and assurance, external payment, cancelling the paid order with a refund
S4.description: A new passenger registers an account (username, password, gender, ID document, e-mail) and logs in with it. Having no contacts yet, they add one (themselves). They search for high-speed (GaoTie/DongChe) trains from Shanghai to Suzhou departing on 1 October 2026, open the details of the first trip found and view the food menu offered on it. They book a first-class seat on that trip for the new contact with food on the train and assurance (insurance) of the first type, without a consignment. They refresh their list of orders, open the new order and check its price. They pay for the order: the internal account balance of a new user is empty, so the payment is completed through the external payment channel. Then they ask how much would be refunded if the paid order were cancelled, cancel it (the refund goes back to the internal balance), and refresh the list of orders filtered by the 'Cancel' status.

S5.title: Advanced search: the cheapest, the quickest and the fewest-stops trips, a transfer via Suzhou; booking the cheapest trip, collecting the ticket and entering the station
S5.description: A registered passenger logs in and uses the advanced search from Shanghai to Nanjing on 1 October 2026 three times: for the cheapest trips, for the quickest trips and for the trips with the fewest stops. They also ask for trips with a transfer at Suzhou (Shanghai — Suzhou — Nanjing) on the same date. The cheapest option turns out to be a regular train (the 'Other' train type, not high-speed): they open its details, take the first contact from their contact book and book a first-class seat on it without food, assurance or consignment. They refresh their list of orders, pay for the order from the internal account balance, collect the ticket and enter the station (board the train) with it.

S6.title: An administrator opens a new high-speed trip and a passenger is the first to buy a ticket on it
S6.description: An administrator logs in to the admin console. They add a new station Ning Bo (stay time 5 minutes), a new train type GaoTieSix (100 second-class and 30 first-class seats, average speed 300), a new route Shanghai — Suzhou — Ning Bo (distances 0, 100 and 250), a price configuration for GaoTieSix on this route (basic rate 0.5, first-class rate 1.2) and a new high-speed trip G9101 of type GaoTieSix on this route from Shanghai via Suzhou to Ning Bo (departure 09:00, arrival 12:00). Then a registered passenger logs in, searches for high-speed (GaoTie/DongChe) trains from Shanghai to Ning Bo departing on 1 October 2026, opens the details of the new trip, takes the first contact from the contact book, books a first-class seat on it without food, assurance or consignment, refreshes the list of orders and pays for the order from the internal account balance. Finally the administrator opens the list of all orders in the system.

steps.action: Log in to the admin console with the administrator's username and password
Add a new station Ning Bo with a stay time of 5 minutes
Add a new train type GaoTieSix with 100 second-class and 30 first-class seats and an average speed of 300
Add a new route Shanghai — Suzhou — Ning Bo with distances 0, 100 and 250
Add a price configuration for train type GaoTieSix on the new route: basic rate 0.5, first-class rate 1.2
Add a new high-speed trip G9101 of type GaoTieSix on the new route from Shanghai via Suzhou to Ning Bo, departing 09:00 and arriving 12:00
Log in as a passenger with username and password
Search high-speed (GaoTie/DongChe) trains from Shanghai to Ning Bo departing on 1 October 2026
Open the details of the new trip found
Open the contact book and take the first contact
Book a first-class seat on the new trip for this contact, without food, assurance or consignment
Refresh the list of orders
Pay for the order from the internal account balance
As the administrator, open the list of all orders in the system

S7.title: After collecting the ticket: refused cancellation and rebooking, changing the consignee, orders filtered by dates
S7.description: A registered passenger logs in, searches for high-speed (GaoTie/DongChe) trains from Shanghai to Suzhou departing on 1 October 2026, takes the first contact from the contact book and books a first-class seat on the first trip found with a luggage consignment of 3 kg to a consignee, without food or assurance. They refresh the list of orders, pay for the order from the internal account balance and collect the ticket. Then they ask how much would be refunded for this order and try to cancel it — the system refuses, because the ticket has already been collected; they try to rebook the order onto the second high-speed trip found — the system refuses for the same reason. They look up the luggage consignment of the order and change the consignee's name and phone number. Finally they refresh the list of orders filtered by travel date (September — December 2026) and then filtered by purchase date (today).

steps.action: Log in with username and password
Search high-speed (GaoTie/DongChe) trains from Shanghai to Suzhou departing on 1 October 2026
Open the contact book and take the first contact
Book a first-class seat on the first trip found for this contact, with a luggage consignment of 3 kg to a consignee, without food or assurance
Refresh the list of orders
Pay for the order from the internal account balance
Collect the ticket for the order
Ask how much would be refunded for the collected order
Try to cancel the collected order (the system refuses)
Try to rebook the collected order onto the second high-speed trip found (the system refuses)
Look up the luggage consignment of the order
Change the consignee's name and phone number in the consignment
Refresh the list of orders filtered by travel date (September — December 2026)
Refresh the list of orders filtered by purchase date (today)
